The order establishes a White House task force

- The curfew includes Paris's Place de la République,

President Emmanuel Macron and his government

of the Gulf of Mexico dramatically declined.
That's according to a new major multi-year study.
Fish populations dropped by about 60%,

Researchers said there's no other cause they could find

Dispersants used after the spill caused many problems

- Three years after the Supreme Court struck down
affirmative action in college admissions,
it will consider the issue of race in admissions
for four selective middle schools.
The case focuses on the school's shift to a lottery system
that the county says ensures fair admissions opportunities
for all students.
A group of parents who sued disagree.
They say it discriminates based on race,
specifically against Asian-American students.
The case has been dismissed twice by lower courts,
but will be argued sometime
before the court's term ends next summer.
Sequoia Carillo, NPR News.
